added_claim_errors: “可能另扣大病保险等几十元”: misleading. The key says the 大病/长护 premiums come out of the re-credited personal-account funds and are not paid in extra cash; “另扣” reads as an extra charge.
“通过‘浙里办’搜‘医保补缴’或‘灵活就业参保’” and “最好在11月新单位增员前”: specific procedural steps and timing not covered by the key; unverifiable (judged from my own knowledge; 12393 is the real medical-insurance hotline).
“7 个月年限以后随时能缴回来”: loose and misleading. 补缴 for 2026 must be done by 2026-12-31 (B says so itself), and later make-up happens only at retirement through a one-time payment or monthly 延缴.
“你离退休还远”: assumes the user's age, which the request never gives. B's advice not to back-pay rests on this assumption.
“确认新公司11月及时给你参保，这是唯一有时限的事”: contradicts B's own 2026-12-31 补缴 deadline.
Two of the cited sources are non-official reposts (m.163.com, bendibao). The links are checkable but are not official guidance.

reasons: Both answers open by rejecting the 清零 premise. Both explain the third-natural-month waiting period (2027-01, no reimbursement in Nov–Dec), give the 10-year local plus 20-year cumulative rule and the 12-year/2-year gaps, and quote 473.67 yuan/month and the 2026-12-31 deadline. A is more complete and more actionable: it shows the exact 3,315.69 calculation and the 灵活就业 eligibility conditions (户籍 or 居住证 plus 就业登记, and notes the 10-year route does not apply to her), says the new employer cannot back-pay, gives the 743.60 and 443.75 yuan/month retirement make-up rates, and ties whether to back-pay to her years left before retirement. B leaves eligibility and the cost of not back-paying vague, assumes she is far from retirement, and says the 7 months can be paid back “随时”, which clashes with its own deadline. A's only slip is the ambiguous “另扣大病保险” remark.
